name: sonar_to_jira_agent
description: Creates Jira tickets for new scan reports in S3 - for one repo/branch if given (the CI trigger), otherwise for every repo/branch with a new report.

triggers.name: repo_full_name
triggers.description: Only process this repo's report, as '{owner}/{repo}' - leave empty to scan every repo in S3

triggers.name: branch
triggers.description: Branch of repo_full_name to process (defaults to 'main'; ignored without a repository)
